# lumiqgen

> Free QR code generator (no signup, no watermark, no expiry) and a dynamic QR
> platform with editable destinations and scan analytics. A product of Luminara
> Software Solutions. Live at https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co

## Free generators (100% client-side; nothing is uploaded)

- [Website URL QR code](https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co/qr/url)
- [WhatsApp QR code](https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co/qr/whatsapp)
- [UPI payment QR code](https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co/qr/upi)
- [Wi-Fi QR code](https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co/qr/wifi)
- [Google Review QR code](https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co/qr/google-review)
- [vCard contact QR code](https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co/qr/vcard)
- [Email QR code](https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co/qr/email)
- [SMS QR code](https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co/qr/sms)
- [Phone call QR code](https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co/qr/phone)
- [Plain text QR code](https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co/qr/text)

## Dynamic QR (paid, from ₹199/month; first 3 free)

- Printed pattern encodes a short redirect link whose destination stays
  editable forever — reprint nothing.
- Scan analytics: device, OS, browser, country, referrer, unique scans.
- Smart routing: different destinations by platform (iOS/Android/desktop),
  time window, or country.
- [Pricing](https://qgen.luminaraconsulting.co/pricing)

## Key facts

- Static QR codes made here never expire and carry no watermark; they are
  generated in the browser and work independently of this service.
- Dynamic QR redirects answer 302 (never 301) so destinations stay editable.
- Payments in INR via Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking).
